text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
The sun has fallen, and all are asleep on<n>this holy
night. All except...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shuffle...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look at Палмер all sound asleep.<n>Now, for her
present...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waheey! Whatcha looking at, Палмер?<n>Golf stuff?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Палмер
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm checking out these gloves. I've<n>been
wanting to replace my old pair,<n>and the latest
ones just dropped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Палмер
text_block_list.text:
But I'm short on cash, so I'm just window<n>shopping
today. Haha!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! A pair of golf gloves, just for you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your cheerful personality never fails to<n>lift my
spirits, Палмер. I hope these are<n>to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now... who's next?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Snrk! Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nice, she's fast asleep. I've got just the<n>thing for a
good girl like her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. What bothers you so,<n>Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fujiii! I m-misplaced my most precious<n>lucky
amulet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Calm down now, deep breaths. Don't<n>worry, it'll
turn up sooner or later. Do<n>you remember the last
time you saw it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gurk! Sniff... Um, I remember bringing itwith me to the field...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I found your amulet! Hehe, this one took<n>me a
while—the academy field is quite<n>large!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Anyhow, good thing I could find it. I<n>hope you
break into that wonderful<n>smile of yours again.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Time ticks by on this holy night, along<n>with its
surreptitious surprises.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I think that's the last of the presents.<n>Hehe, I can't
wait to see everyone's<n>faces tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm really feeling the cold now.<n>Guess it's
time to get snug in my bed.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a flash catches Fuji Kiseki's<n>eye, and
she looks up to the sky. There,<n>high above the
clouds, she sees...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A shooting star on this holy night. What<n>a stellar
present.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I might as well make a wish.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please, grant these girls enough<n>happiness to last
a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Morning arrives, and Ritto Dormitory<n>buzzes with
festive voices.
